# Module `people` of graph `example_graph`

Prefix `ppl`, version 1.0.0. The people the company works with, employees and externals, and the identities they use in systems; not their positions or units (organization) or their work (operations).

Ontology `company` 1.1.0. The live source is `graph describe module people --graph example_graph --json`; it wins when they differ. Fields, states and relations of a type: `graph describe type <type> --graph example_graph --json`.
